steps.name: The End of the Crossroads
steps.objective: Talk to [Galette] in 「Gerda」 and complete the quest.

lines.speaker: 갈렛
lines.text: Welcome, Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sorry, Galette. I meant to eat with everyone, but something urgent came up.

lines.speaker: 갈렛
lines.text: That's all right. You're welcome at the Snowflower Inn anytime.

lines.speaker: 갈렛
lines.text: It was a true honor to host the Champions, the finest on the continent. They all said they felt empty inside, and ate and drank without stopping.

lines.speaker: 갈렛
lines.text: The ingredients in our storeroom vanished like melting snow. Oh, that was a poor choice of words.

lines.speaker: 갈렛
lines.text: A resident of Gerda talking about snow melting! Io would give me quite a scolding if she heard.

lines.speaker: 갈렛
lines.text: I know Lord Valdrick has a healthy appetite, but I never knew the others did too. I lost count of how many kegs he and Lord Ziskad emptied...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...They didn't get drunk and start sparring, did they?

lines.speaker: 갈렛
lines.text: Io warned them beforehand, so nothing of the sort happened. 'I'll freeze you all to death! Ahahaha!' was how she put it.

lines.speaker: 갈렛
lines.text: Lady Shynic, Io, and Lady Medea were remarkable too. And I was delighted by how much Lord Atkina enjoyed the food.

lines.speaker: 갈렛
lines.text: Don't worry. There's still food left for you, Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Galette. Has everyone gone home?

lines.speaker: 갈렛
lines.text: Yes. They all said they were finally full and left Gerda. Oh, Miss Ren stayed to help out. I think she's out with Frozen at the moment...

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: Miss Ren, is it...

lines.speaker: 갈렛
lines.text: Madeleine, when did you get here?

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: Just now.

lines.speaker: 갈렛
lines.text: What brings you here? Hungry? Would you like a meal?

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: Nothing. I'm leaving right away. Must be nice for you, Galette, having someone volunteer to help.

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: Never mind.

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: Adventurer, thank you for resolving the trouble in Eastland. Thanks to you...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I didn't do it alone.

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: Oh, right. Quite a few people asked me to pass on a message if I saw you. They'll be waiting, so enjoy a good meal at the Snowflower Inn first.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Quite a few people? The Champions?

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: Yes, the Champions, Frozen, and that monk who's apparently called Miss Ren...

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: I've delivered the message, so I'll be going. The Ice Otters are having a snowball fight with frozen sardines. I'd better stop them.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha. Take care, Madeleine.
Grrrowl.
(As the adventurer sees Madeleine off, Galette hears a welcome sound and breaks into a bright smile.)

lines.speaker: 갈렛
lines.text: Heh. My turn to step in!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha. I must be really hungry.

lines.speaker: 갈렛
lines.text: Just a moment, please. Something delicious will be right out!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Galette.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...I wonder what they want. I'd better go see them...)
